name: Cerberus
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategy notes: OSRS Wiki Cerberus/Strategies.
validationNotes: Single-phase fight. Demonbane weapons and the slayer helmet are covered by the reference validation tests. Cerberus can only be fought on a hellhound or Cerberus task, so the slayer-task bonus is always assumed.

requirements.text: Requires an active hellhound or Cerberus slayer task

warnings: The summoned souls drain prayer heavily: the planner adds extra prayer restoration.

strategies.name: Melee
strategies.description: Crush or demonbane weapons in melee range.

strategies.name: Ranged
strategies.description: Ranged from a distance; the twisted bow benefits from Cerberus' high Magic level.
